review_improvement: Adds explicit final-member and population accounting so OAM_7 cannot disappear through truncated enumeration or aggregate evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Parsers and collection loops often reveal off-by-one defects at the last indexed member. An eight-OAM aggregate can appear healthy even if OAM_7 was never enumerated, especially when missing data is filtered. The evidence must therefore prove OAM_7 identity, expected row count and all four-source entries independently before any broader system summary is considered.
